svg.title: The step cap that ships
svg.desc: In panel a, in each of five rounds beside 24 agent sessions, each configuration's share of the round's replies over that round's SLO, against the requirement of at most 5%, and in panel b each one's agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s, the median of its rounds with their range: tuned vLLM, 512-token steps, 53, 55, 55, 54, 44 of 59 by round, 261 of 295 in all, at 3,399 agents' tokens a second (3,066 to 3,486); the configuration to deploy, 512-token steps, 16, 29, 25, 9, 15 of 59 by round, 94 of 295 in all, at 3,303 agents' tokens a second (2,843 to 3,337); the configuration to deploy, 256-token steps, 10, 17, 10, 4, 3 of 59 by round, 44 of 295 in all, at 3,067 agents' tokens a second (2,725 to 3,185); from 512- to 256-token steps the configuration to deploy's agents' tokens a second change by −7%.
